group_reasoning.predecessor-diagnostic-text: _predecessor (aisef2/app/lineage.py:665-701) returns (predecessor_path, why); `why` = "'; '.join(damaged) or None" (L701), a free-text explanation of why the predecessor cannot be told, built from the `damaged` list (L677-698). The ONLY consumer of why ([1]) is lineage_account at lineage.py:759-761: `nxt, why = _predecessor(at); if why: unknown(runs[-1], f"{at.name}: {why}: what it continued, and what the runs before it spent, is unknown")`, which appends that text to the run's `unaccounted` and `unread` lists (unknown(), L719-722; collected L775-777). Those lists reach: (a) RUN.json `continues.account`; (b) client.Budget (client.py:94 inherited_unread, :89 inherited_unaccounted), where reached()/exceeded() (client.py:118-119, 129-130) test only the list's NON-EMPTINESS and prepend a fixed 'unaccounted: ', and client.py:101 wraps each entry as "the lineage's evidence cannot be read, or is gone: {u}"; (c) the `aisef run --parent` claim-stage operator refusal and `aisef run --verify` (verify.py, which names the run DIRECTORIES via lineage.unread_runs -> r['run'] basenames, L784, not the why text). No machine consumer substring-parses the why text: run.py:455 and client.py key on the fixed stop prefix ('max_'/'unaccounted'), unread_runs keys on r['run']. The two things the operator must act on are carried OUTSIDE why: which run (the `{at.name}` basename prefix the caller adds at L761, and the full path via unread_runs/the refusal template; test_v21_x_lineage_proof.py:975-982 pins the path str) and the remediation ('make it readable again, a faithful copy'; refusal template, client.py:101 / lineage.py:302,319,376; assert_what_to_do needles at x_lineage_proof.py:772-775 come from the TEMPLATE, not from why). predecessor_of (L705) uses only [0] and is unaffected. MEASUREMENT: the 3 registered kill files (test_v21_x_lineage_proof, test_v21_defects_verify, test_v21_kills3_T09c) each PASS on every one of these mutants and PASS unmutated (baseline OK); they assert only that unread/unaccounted is non-empty, that total is None, and that an entry contains the RUN NAME (assert_unread, x_lineage_proof.py:260-265; test_no_flag_opens_a_session..., :904-906) plus the template needles -- never the _predecessor damage-kind phrase. Hence every mutant SURVIVED by measurement, as campaign 9 recorded. These are operator-readable strings (owner rule: not 'harmless'); classified AUDITED, not EQUIVALENT (each changes the operator text), and not REFUTED (no test/doc/verifier/machine consumer and no operator ACTION depends on the exact phrase; the run identity and the remediation are carried elsewhere -- a test on the phrase would pin cosmetic text, which the owner rule forbids adding to reach a number).
